description: This file provides utility functions for enriching documents with normalized project IDs and updated timestamps. It includes functions to normalize various possible formats of projectId, parse dates from different fields, and compute the latest update time from document fields. It is intended for internal use in a larger codebase to standardize document metadata.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId(input)
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of projectId fields to a lowercase string ID, handling strings, numbers, objects with common projectId-related fields, and Mongo ObjectId-like objects.

methods.name: toValidDate(val)
methods.description: Parses a value into a valid Date object if possible, returning null otherwise.

methods.name: computeUpdatedAt(doc)
methods.description: Computes the most relevant 'updated at' Date from a document's various timestamp fields or from its _id timestamp if available.

methods.name: enrichDeployment(doc)
methods.description: Given a deployment-like document, returns an object containing normalized projectId and updatedAt timestamp, utilizing the other two functions.
